sql: SELECT "budget"."link_to_event" AS e, "event"."type" AS g, AVG((CAST(("budget"."spent" - "budget"."amount") AS REAL) / "budget"."amount")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "budget" JOIN "event" ON "event"."event_id" = "budget"."link_to_event"  GROUP BY "budget"."link_to_event", "event"."type" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.relative difference of amount spent in category from amount budgeted
why: (amount spent in category - amount budgeted) / amount budgeted: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of amount spent in category from amount budgeted per event within event.type
